metadata.transfer_regime: Zero-Shot 3D Transfer to 4 Unseen GABAergic & Basal Ganglia Pockets
metadata.disclaimer: All generated ligands and docking poses are strictly in silico computational research hypotheses and are NOT clinically validated medicines or medical advice.

DRD1.circuit_role: Postsynaptic striatonigral D1-MSN accelerator; blockade dampens tic execution
DRD1.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: GPCRdb=Inactive (9LLG flupentixol + NAM GEM, no G-protein)
DRD1.audit_notes: Primary 9LLG (2.77 A) is confirmed GPCRdb=Inactive antagonist-bound (valid!). CAVEAT on secondary PDB 9URL (3.04 A, SKF-83566): live RCSB & coordinate audit proves 9URL is a Gs-coupled DRD1-Gs complex (TM3 Arg121-TM6 Thr268 CA = 20.09 A vs 19.46 A in active 7LJC), so 9LLG—not 9URL—must be used for inactive-state docking.

DRD2.circuit_role: Postsynaptic striatopallidal Gi/o brake-suppressor; blockade restores No-Go
DRD2.audit_notes: Clinically gold-standard TS mechanism (haloperidol, pimozide, aripiprazole FDA approved for TS), but >80% striatal D2 occupancy drives EPS, tardive dyskinesia, and hyperprolactinemia; serves dual role as benchmark & anti-EPS counter-target.

VMAT2.circuit_role: Presynaptic vesicular dopamine/monoamine loader; inhibition depletes DA release
VMAT2.audit_notes: Structurally 100% valid human Q05940/CHEMBL1893 (8T69 2.89 A, 9KQ8 3.38 A). CRITICAL CLINICAL AUDIT: Both valbenazine (T-Force GREEN/GOLD, T-Forward) and deutetrabenazine (ARTISTS 1 & 2) FAILED primary YGTSS-TTS endpoints in TS trials (FDA-approved for TD & Huntington chorea; off-label/exploratory in TS).

ADRA2A.circuit_role: Postsynaptic PFC dendritic spine Gi/o closure of HCN channels -> top-down CSTC gating
ADRA2A.audit_notes: 7EJ8 (3.00 A) & 9CBL (2.80 A) are verified Active agonist-bound templates (+15 numbering offset properly aliased: Asp128=Asp113). Anatomically PFC top-down gate (NOT striatal!). Note: secondary PDB 6KUX (RS79948) is an Inactive antagonist control.

HRH3.circuit_role: Presynaptic histaminergic Gi/o autoreceptor & striatal MSN heteroreceptor
HRH3.audit_notes: Polarity VERIFIED: HDC W317X familial TS causes central histamine deficiency, so blocking presynaptic HRH3 (Inactive 7F61) increases histamine release. CAVEATS: (1) Secondary PDBs 8YN5/8YN8 are Active agonist controls, not antagonist templates; (2) AZD5213 FAILED Ph2 in adolescent TS (NCT01904773); pitolisant lacks Ph3 TS RCT.

PDE10A.circuit_role: Striatal D1/D2-MSN cAMP/cGMP hydrolase; inhibition preferentially activates D2 No-Go
PDE10A.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: Human Q9Y233 catalytic inhibited (5SJX MP-10, Zn2+/Mg2+)
PDE10A.audit_notes: Verified Homo sapiens Q9Y233 (rat 3HR1 excluded); strongest active non-D1 clinical TS pipeline: gemlapodect (NOE-105) met Phase 2a ALLEVIA-1 endpoints and is in global double-blind Phase 2b ALLEVIA-2.

MGLL.circuit_role: Degrades striatal 2-AG; reversible inhibition elevates CB1 retrograde synaptic braking
MGLL.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: 1.14 A human non-covalent reversible catalytic inhibited (9F8D)
MGLL.audit_notes: 9F8D (1.14 A) is structurally pristine and strictly non-covalent. CLINICAL CAVEAT: Irreversible covalent MAGL inhibitor Lu AG06466 (elcubragistat) failed Phase 2a in adult TS (attributed partly to CB1 receptor desensitization); reversible MAGL remains an unproven translational hypothesis.

PDE1B.circuit_role: Ca2+/calmodulin-activated striatal D1-MSN & PFC cAMP/cGMP modulator
PDE1B.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: 1.82 A human Q01064 catalytic inhibited (5UOY, Zn2+/Mg2+)
PDE1B.audit_notes: High-resolution human pocket (5UOY 1.82 A); however, PDE1B inhibition elevates cAMP in D1-MSNs (potentially enhancing D1 signaling) and lacks clinical TS efficacy data (primary rationale is CIAS/cognition and PDE10A selectivity profiling).

GPR52.circuit_role: Gs-coupled striatal D2-MSN orphan GPCR opposing Gi-coupled DRD2 signaling
GPR52.audit_notes: 8HMP (2.77 A) correctly uses active Gs-coupled conformation (avoiding inactive X-ray 6LI0). Strong mechanistic fit for non-D2 striatal No-Go brake (HTL0048149 Ph1/2 SCZ).

GABRA5.circuit_role: Heteropentameric GABA-A alpha5+/gamma2- Cl- channel mediating tonic GABAergic impulse braking without alpha1 full-agonist sedation
GABRA5.therapeutic_polarity: PAM (Partial positive allosteric modulator at alpha5+/gamma2-)
GABRA5.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: 2.39 A X-ray multi-chain alpha5+(C)/gamma2-(B) Bretazenil partial PAM (0 pocket muts)
GABRA5.audit_notes: Directly addresses the ~50% striatal PV+ GABAergic interneuron deficit in TS (Kalanithi PNAS 2005; Kataoka J. Neurosci. 2010) and clinical clonazepam efficacy. Multi-chain extractor isolates canonical B:QMU502 interface (and 6X3X D:DZP404 vs TMD anesthetic copies). Human GABRA6 (Q16445, DK-I-56-1) has 0 experimental PDBs.

GAT1.circuit_role: Presynaptic/astrocytic synaptic GABA clearance transporter; blockade prolongs inhibitory GABAergic impulse braking in striatum, GPe/GPi, and motor cortex
GAT1.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: 3.20 A cryo-EM 100% WT human SLC6A1 + FDA drug Tiagabine (TGI)
GAT1.audit_notes: 532/532 residues 100% WT Homo sapiens P30531; directly elevates endogenous synaptic GABA (the 'acid that slows down impulses'). Preferentially chosen over ABAT (0 human PDBs; all 9 PDBs are Sus scrofa pig P80147) and complements GABA-A PAM modulation.

ADORA2A.circuit_role: Striatopallidal D2-MSN Gs/Golf receptor forming antagonistic A2A-D2 heteromers; agonism allosterically trans-inhibits DRD2 and strengthens the No-Go motor filter
ADORA2A.therapeutic_polarity: AGONIST (Active miniGs-coupled state — OPPOSITE of Parkinson's!)
ADORA2A.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: GPCRdb=Active (9EE8 2.63 A Apr 2025 cryo-EM miniGs + Adenosine, 0 pocket mutations)
ADORA2A.audit_notes: Ultra-clean 2025 active G-protein-coupled human pocket (avoids Q89A mutation in 2YDV and excludes inactive Parkinson's antagonists 5NM4/8GNG). TRANSLATIONAL CAVEAT: systemic full ribose A2A agonists cause hypotension/vasodilation and poor BBB entry (MPO 3.00), motivating CNS-penetrant non-ribose partial agonists (e.g., LUF5833).

GRM5.circuit_role: Postsynaptic corticostriatal & subthalamic (STN) Gq/11 glutamate receptor; NAMs dampen hyper-glutamatergic tic/dyskinetic drive while preserving baseline tone
GRM5.gpcrdb_or_structural_state: GPCRdb=Inactive (4OO9 2.60 A X-ray Mavoglurant, canonical P41594 numbering)
GRM5.audit_notes: 4OO9 avoids T4L numbering offsets (+160 in 6FFI, +1000 in 6FFH) and has 4,320 human ChEMBL 37 activities. CAVEAT: Clinical PD-LID signals (dipraglurant/mavoglurant) have not yet been validated in TS RCTs; alkyne NAMs require GSH-adduct de-risking.

GABRA6.verdict: Preclinically compelling (DK-I-56-1 / LAU-176 alpha6-PAM Tourette models), but ZERO experimental human PDB structures exist; requires homology modeling from human alpha5/gamma2 (8BHG) or alpha1/beta2/gamma2 (6X3X).

ABAT.verdict: SPECIES TRAP: 0 Homo sapiens PDB structures exist; all 9 RCSB entries (4Y0H, 1OHV, etc.) are Sus scrofa (pig P80147). Moreover, irreversible vigabatrin carries black-box irreversible retinal/visual-field toxicity.

GRIN2B.verdict: SPECIES-CHIMERA TRAP: High-res ifenprodil ATD complex 5EWJ (2.77 A) is a Xenopus laevis GluN1 (A0A1L8F5J9) + Homo sapiens GluN2B chimera, 4PE5 is Rattus norvegicus, and full-human 7EU8 is 4.07 A.

GABBR1_GABBR2.verdict: Valid human cryo-EM (7C7Q 3.0 A active baclofen + rac-BHFF PAM; clinical pediatric TS crossover RCT evidence for baclofen), but sparse human ChEMBL bioactivity (81 complex / 8 GABBR1 records) vs GAT1/GABRA5/ADORA2A/GRM5.

CNR1.verdict: Rich human structural & ChEMBL data (5XRA 2.8 A active agonist, 6N4B 3.0 A Gi-coupled; nabiximols/THC clinical TS signals), deprioritized behind MGLL already in atlas due to direct CB1 psychoactivity/tolerance liability.

GRM4.verdict: Mechanistically relevant presynaptic GPe indirect-pathway brake, but only low-resolution 4.0 A apo/phosphoserine human cryo-EM (7E9H, no 7TM PAM).
